GENERAL SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Guess results without recording observations on Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

   D. Guess results without recording observations on The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a.

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

8. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res? (1 mark)
